intent: Localize influence in the already-measured nested T5 radius-selection association using only paired outer county-fold SSEs from the frozen source report.

interpretation.conclusion: This is a non-mutating county influence diagnostic on a frozen feature-only association with the S1 disagreement residual; it does not measure target accuracy or authorize a new estimator.
interpretation.influence_definition: leave-one-county-out pooled ΔR² minus full-sample pooled ΔR²; max influence is the largest absolute change
interpretation.sign_reversal_definition: strictly opposite nonzero signs between full-sample pooled ΔR² and the leave-one-county-out pooled ΔR²; exact zeros counted separately
